description: Wallet PnL. Calls only GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/pnl and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching wallet PnL with realized and unrealized profit, win rate, trade volume and per-token performance across vetted markets.

limit.description: The limit of entries to return. If not passed, first 1000 entries are returned (the maximum).

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/pnl.

resolution.description: Represents the supported time-window resolutions for account/PnL queries.
